name: 2022-23 Regular - MIE 1071-B  Basic Mechanical Engineering
subject: Basic Mechanical Engineering

questions.markdown: Two boilers are used to deliver steam into a common pipeline. The pressure in the boilers and in the common pipeline is 10 bar. Boiler-1 generates dry steam and the temperature of steam in the common pipeline is $200^\circ\text{C}$. If boiler-1 supplies 2 kg of steam as compared to 4 kg from boiler-2, what is the condition of steam generated by boiler-2? Also find the related parameter of steam.

A steam boiler generates steam at the rate of 3000 kg per hour at $0.5\,\text{MPa}$ and $230^\circ\text{C}$ and is fed with coal at the rate of 1500 kg/hr which has a calorific value of $24\,\text{MJ/kg}$. The water is fed to the boiler at a temperature $25^\circ\text{C}$. If the boiler performance is to be enhanced by 10% by preheating feed water by $5^\circ\text{C}$, what will be the percentage reduction in coal consumption?
Explain the devices used to recover the waste exhaust gas heat coming out from the steam boiler furnace for preheating of air and feed water.

The machine and motor shafts are placed at a centre distance of 5 m. The motor drives the machine shaft using a flat belt drive system in which the machine shaft rotates in the same direction as the motor shaft. The tight side tension in the belt is 1500 N. The speed and diameter of the larger pulley are 300 rpm and 1500 mm respectively. If the speed reduction ratio is 5, determine the power transmitted by the belt drive. Assume the coefficient of friction between the belt and the pulley surface as 0.4.

A power transmission system makes use of gear drive system with an aim to achieve maximum velocity ratio using the following gears:

- Gears A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H have a gear teeth of 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 80, 120 and 140 respectively.
- Gears A, B, D, E and H has a circular pitch of 2 mm while the rest have a circular pitch of 3 mm.

What will be the maximum velocity ratio achievable from these set of gears? If all the gears have the same circular pitch of 3 mm, and a simple gear train is to be used, then what will be percentage change in maximum achievable velocity ratio? Show the gear arrangements for both cases.
What are the advantages and limitations of gear drive systems?

A twin cylinder two stroke petrol engine with stroke to bore ratio of 1.2 develops 64 kW at 5000 rpm. The mean effective pressure on the piston is 16 bar and mechanical efficiency is 80 %. Determine (i) diameter and stroke of each cylinder (ii) brake thermal efficiency and (iii) indicated thermal efficiency, if the fuel consumption is 16 kg/hr and the fuel is having calorific value of 44000 kJ/kg.

Explain the working of an engine fitted with a cam shaft and operating on a thermodynamic cycle wherein the heat rejection and addition takes place at constant volume and constant pressure respectively. Support your answer with neat sketches of each stage.

Justify the following statements:

i) 2 stroke engines are not environment friendly.

ii) Diesel engines are bulkier than petrol engines for the same power output.

A workshop has got an order for turning two types of shafts. One with a length 1 m and diameter of 50 mm and another shaft with a length of 0.5 m and diameter of 100 mm. To produce these shafts, the workshop is planning to install one engine lathe at its facility. Suggest the workshop regarding the right lathe specifications to be considered while procuring the engine lathe with proper justifications.

A hole of standard size is to be drilled to accommodate a round headed bolt. Suggest the right sequence of operations that are to be carried out to accomplish the given task. Also, sketch and explain the suggested operations.
Explain the significance of any of the three stages involved in making of parts using Additive Manufacturing.

Explain the role of the following in casting process.

i) Pattern

ii) Core

iii) Sprue pins

iv) Vent holes
Sketch and explain the welding process wherein two steel plates are to be joined with the use of filler material and employing a non-consumable electrode.
What are the different components that make an automated system? Explain using a block diagram.
